hni_signals: Clinical Director of Surgical Oncology at Yashoda Hospitals Hitec City; Senior Consultant Surgical Oncology & Robotic Surgical Oncology. Founder & Director of Grace Cancer Foundation and Global CEO, Grace Cancer Foundation / Global Grace Health (per his official website). Advanced training at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Institute (New York), Roswell Park Cancer Institute (Buffalo) and New Tokyo Hospital (Japan); MCh Surgical Oncology from Gujarat Cancer Research Institute (ranked 2nd in university). Qualifications: MS (Gen Surg), MCh (Surg Onco), FIAGES, PDCR. Runs his own professional website (drchinnababu.com) and an active multi-platform social presence. Medical registration APMC/FMR/74264.
